messages:
Aisha: CI on my PR #412 just turned red after the CMake/toolchain image roll. Multiple linux-dbg shards failing with lots of undefined references and missing exported symbols. Anyone else seeing this?
ci-bot: Build failed: //services/runtime:all (linux-dbg) — logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/2147654321/logs
Ben: seeing the same on #410. Link errors look like symbol versioning / missing exports rather than compile errors. Example: 'undefined reference to `redwood::InitRuntime()'.
Carlos: tagging eng-infra — can someone try a bisect on the toolchain image? The roll went out ~03-15.
Emily: I'll kicked a rerun for the failing shard to rule out flakiness.
devops-bot: Rerun requested by Emily for build 2147654321-shard-7.
Frank: rerun still fails. Attaching relevant tail of the linker command: ```/usr/bin/ld -shared -o libred.so obj1.o obj2.o -lredwood_runtime -Wl,--version-script,exports.map``` and then multiple undefined refs.
Harper: Quick check — did any CMakeLists change symbol visibility or add a version script in the last week? @Aisha
Aisha: no CMake changes in my PR (only proto regen). The only thing that changed org-wide was the GCC toolchain image bump to gcc-12.2.0 last night.
Ben: that fits — GCC 12.2 had different default visibility and subtle ABI footguns on our old build flags. Can we try pinning the image to the previous one in CI to see if it passes?
Carlos: I can start a quick bisect: run the matrix with previous image tag and current image tag to isolate when it broke.
Emily: FYI I created a temporary branch that pins the toolchain to image: gcc-12.1.0 and kicked the full matrix: https://ci.redwood/internal/2147654321/pinned
Frank: matrix with pinned image passed all previously failing shards :tada: so looks like the toolchain roll is the culprit.
Aisha: thanks — please capture the exact failing linker invocation and open an issue for the toolchain/infra team. I'll add a temporary CI guard to pin until we have a fix.
Carlos: filed https://issues.redwood/RED-1234 with logs, bisect notes, and the failing link lines. Assigned to eng-infra-toolchain, labels: regression, high-priority.
Ben: for immediate mitigation I'm pushing a hotfix to CI images that adds a compatibility symlink and an alternate export map to avoid breakage for inbound PRs. Will coordinate with infra to revert once upstream fix lands.
Harper: if the toolchain team needs a minimal reproducer (small CMake + shared lib) I can assemble and share a Dockerfile with the pinned and rolled images. Ping me.
devops-bot: Noted. Temporarily pinned toolchain in CI matrix for default PR runs.
ci-bot: Marking thread RESOLVED_FOR_NOW — regression tracked in RED-1234. Reopen if failures recur.
Aisha: thanks everyone for the quick triage and bisect.
